dedupe_keys.name: low voltage load forecasting dataset directory

description: This directory describes published electricity-load datasets for forecasting research, including residential, commercial, industrial and substation observations. The authors of the Review of Low-Voltage Load Forecasting and community contributors maintain a public comparison table and repository metadata in YAML. Fields record dataset links, customer or asset counts, measurement intervals, durations, interventions, submetering, weather availability, locations, additional variables and access conditions. Entries span multiple countries and periods, from short high-frequency campaigns to multiyear smart-meter and feeder records; the directory has no single observation calendar or spatial resolution. Metadata are free under CC BY 4.0 and the website code uses MIT. Individual linked datasets retain their own terms, including research applications and registration. A limitation is that the maintainers explicitly describe the YAML as not fully standardised or harmonised, and linked licences and endpoints can age. Simulation uses include selecting comparable load inputs and identifying calibration benchmarks with suitable resolution and customer scale. It relates to data-building-data-genome-2 as one existing building-observation resource, but this record covers discovery metadata, not raw measurements. The table was read; all linked datasets have not yet been individually verified.
